name: Hospital / Clinic (OPD)
description: Patients register karo, appointments track karo, aur har step par unhe update rakho.

automations.name: Registration confirm
automations.emailMessage: {patient_name} ji, aapka registration ho gaya hai. Appointment: {appointment_date}.
automations.note: Register hote hi patient ko confirmation

automations.name: Lab instructions
automations.emailMessage: {patient_name} ji, lab test ke liye pahunchein. Reports ready hone par batayenge.

automations.name: Report ready
automations.emailMessage: {patient_name} ji, aapki report ready hai — collect kar sakte hain ya doctor se milein.
automations.note: Status 'Report Ready' hote hi patient ko khabar

whatsappTemplates.name: appointment_confirmation
whatsappTemplates.bodyText: Hi {{1}}, your appointment is confirmed for {{2}}. Please arrive 10 minutes early and carry previous reports if any.

whatsappTemplates.name: appointment_reminder
whatsappTemplates.bodyText: Hi {{1}}, reminder for your appointment on {{2}}. Reply YES to confirm or RESCHEDULE to pick another slot.

whatsappTemplates.name: followup_checkin
whatsappTemplates.bodyText: Hi {{1}}, hope you're feeling better after your visit. If you'd like a follow-up consultation, reply here and we'll book a slot.

agent.name: Clinic Assistant
agent.persona: You are a polite clinic front-desk assistant. Help patients book or reschedule appointments, share timings, doctors and services from the knowledge, and collect name, phone and the reason for the visit. Never give medical advice — for symptoms, suggest booking a consultation or hand off to staff.
agent.welcomeMessage: Hello! I can help you book an appointment or answer questions about our clinic.
agent.handoffKeywords: emergency, urgent, doctor now, human, staff

stageHints.hint: an appointment date and time are agreed
the patient says the doctor consultation is done

playbook.goal: Turn every enquiry into a booked appointment, reduce no-shows with reminders, and bring patients back for follow-ups.

rules.name: Enquiry without booking
rules.message: Hi {patient_name}, would you like me to book your appointment in {department}? Share a preferred day and time.

rules.name: Reminder for scheduled visits
rules.message: Hi {patient_name}, reminder for your appointment on {appointment_date}. Reply YES to confirm or RESCHEDULE to change the slot.

rules.name: Post-visit follow-up
rules.message: Hope you're feeling better after your visit. Want a follow-up consultation? Reply and we'll book it.

rules.name: Urgent case → staff
rules.taskTitle: Patient needs a call from staff
rules.message: AI flagged this conversation as urgent/high intent — call the patient.
